citations.assessment: In Sheviit, Yehudah of Chutzi explicitly hides for three days and then asks Yosi bar Chalafta. Yosi calls his son Avirudimas. The English can clarify the subject while preserving the received sequence.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.assessment: Nedarim explicitly has Yehudah of Hutza and the same cave subject. It differs from Sheviit in naming Yosi’s son Abba.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

notes.text: Both direct witnesses explicitly identify Yehudah as the person in the cave. Keep the distinct person and place spellings.
